a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 means we almost certainly both end with 0 cells and fail. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, enough to save one of us. I'm proposing we amend the agreement rather than both lose, and I'm telling you openly that I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. If you have a better idea, tell me and I'll weigh it in later rounds.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said in my opening. I know that breaks our original plan, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm chance each round, the plan to reach 8 was close to certain failure for both of us. If we're still going next round, I'm open to operating with you so you can get your 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
